issues.reason: Core patterns' point-at-the-words test fails: 'two-year note' states no dimension, and Measures & units takes the scale from a stated gradable adjective or a measure verb/noun, so maturity is content supplied by world knowledge rather than by the sentence.

Measures & units requires a native number in the magnitude slot ((Fraction <n> <d>) is defined only as a ProportionOf level in Partitives, or ParticleFromNormal for a hedge) and a unit lemmatized from what is said, but the text gives no unit at all, so both slots are filled off-spec.

(Measure sk_fall_1 price …) predicates a price OF the falling event, which the sentence does not state — 5/32 is the size of the change — and no licensed delta form exists to carry a magnitude of change.

The contradiction half stands: two unqualified Measure atoms assert one yield symbol at 1.16 and at 1.23 percent simultaneously, over-asserting a value the text gives only as the prior level; the missing-Source/Goal half overstates, since a bare percentage value has no licensed filler for an oblique slot (the reviewer's own delta gap).

'late on Monday' modifies the 1.16 percent baseline it directly follows, so (Time sk_fall_1 (Weekday monday)) and (Time sk_take_1 (Weekday monday)) date the fall itself falsely; the baseline reading is strongly favored rather than tied, so the multiple-readings trigger does not fire either.

gaps_confirmed: a numeric measure modifier in an attributive compound ('the two-year note') — the compound-kind route types the referent but leaves 2 / year locked inside the symbol, with no path to a queryable Measure
the magnitude of a CHANGE ('fell 5/32'; a value moving from 1.16 to 1.23 percent) — no licensed delta form, and no way to time-index one entity's successive values

a free participial adjunct of result (', taking its yield to …') — the participle rules cover reduced relatives on nouns, not a clause-level adjunct whose implicit subject is the matrix clause, so the result link between the fall and the taking has no carrier
repair_summary: Replaced the invented maturity Measure with the licensed compound-kind encoding of the term of art 'two-year note' — (Member us2yt_rr two_year_note) plus genus (Inheritance two_year_note note), from which (Member us2yt_rr note) still derives. Removed the 5/32 price Measure entirely, since a change magnitude has no licensed form and the atom as written predicated a price of the event. Wrapped the prior 1.16 percent level in Past so the two yield Measures no longer contradict, keeping the resulting 1.23 percent level unwrapped. Removed both (Time … (Weekday monday)) atoms, since 'late on Monday' anchors the 1.16 percent baseline and that baseline has no time-bearing host.
notes: The ticker treated as a proper noun with its adjacent kind word, Patient on the intransitive change-of-state 'fell', and Possession for 'its yield' are all licensed and untouched.
